comment: Files the 3DS and Switch emulators ask for that droidtop-platforms' bios-database.json has no rows for. Each names a file of Abdess/retrobios by its path; gen_index.py takes size and hashes from retrobios' own database and refuses a path it no longer lists. Console-unique dumps (otp.bin, movable.sed, SecureInfo) are left out on purpose: they are not shared files.

files.name: aes_keys.txt
files.note: The 3DS encryption keys Azahar and Citra-family emulators read to open encrypted games. Goes in the emulator's sysdata folder.

files.name: boot9.bin
files.note: The 3DS boot ROM. Goes in the emulator's sysdata folder.

files.name: seeddb.bin
files.note: Seed database for games whose content is encrypted with a seed. Goes in the emulator's sysdata folder.

files.name: shared_font.bin
files.note: The 3DS shared font, for games that draw text with the system font. Goes in the emulator's sysdata folder.

files.name: prod.keys
files.note: The Switch production keys Yuzu-family emulators need to run any game. Goes in the emulator's keys folder.

files.name: title.keys
files.note: Title keys for games that ship with their own. Goes in the emulator's keys folder.

files.name: Firmware_batocera43.zip
files.note: A Switch firmware package (large). Unpack it into the emulator's nand system contents, or install it from the emulator's own menu.
